reasoning_content:
The frontend depends on services being healthy. Some services fail readiness probes because migrations take too long (60s readiness timeout). The processes died due to readiness check fail during migrations. Let me look at the readiness probe config and see if services recover on restart (availability restart on_failure). Many are "Completed exit=1" meaning restart not configured or restart exhausted.

Actually, the underlying cause: first startup runs all DB migrations, which takes >readiness timeout (60s default?). The processes with `restart: on_failure` should restart. Let's check availability settings. Some have restart on_failure. But status shows "Completed" not restarting. Let me look at process-compose config for availability and readiness for project-logic.

action.command: cd /workspace && sed -n '60,120p' process-compose.yaml; echo "=== formal ==="; grep -n "formal-completeness:" -A 30 process-compose.yaml | head -40
